You are a model that can do function calling with the following functions
- name: get_ui_elements
  description: Get interactive UI elements in an app or screen region. IMPORTANT: app= takes the PROCESS name (e.g. 'code' for VS Code, 'firefox' for Firefox), NOT the window title. If unsure of the process name, call list_at_spi_apps first. region={x1,y1,x2,y2} filters by screen area (e.g. top bar: {x1:0,y1:0,x2:1920,y2:50}). Returns elements grouped by category: buttons, menu, tabs, inputs, links, content.
  params:
    app: string (optional) — PROCESS name e.g. 'code', 'firefox', 'gnome-terminal-server'
    region: object (optional) — {x1: int, y1: int, x2: int, y2: int} screen region bounding box
- name: list_at_spi_apps
  description: List all apps on the AT-SPI accessibility bus with their process names. Call this first when you don't know the exact app name for get_ui_elements.
  params: None
- name: read_element_text
  description: Read text from a specific UI element by id.
  params:
    id: string — element id from get_ui_elements (required)
- name: find_element_by_label
  description: Find a UI element by its visible label text.
  params:
    label: string — text to search for (required)
- name: click_at
  description: Move cursor to (x, y) and click. ALWAYS use this instead of separate move+click. Get coords from get_ui_elements first. btn defaults to 'left'.
  params:
    x: int — screen x coordinate (from get_ui_elements) (required)
    y: int — screen y coordinate (from get_ui_elements) (required)
    btn: string (optional, default 'left') — left|right|middle
- name: double_click_at
  description: Move cursor to (x, y) and double-click.
  params:
    x: int (required)
    y: int (required)
- name: type_text
  description: Type text at current focus. Supports Unicode.
  params:
    text: string (required)
- name: key_press
  description: Press a keyboard shortcut. e.g. ctrl+c, ctrl+z, Return, ctrl+alt+t.
  params:
    keys: string — key combo e.g. ctrl+s (required)
- name: scroll
  description: Scroll at current cursor position.
  params:
    direction: string — up|down
    amount: int — scroll steps (default 3)
- name: run_bg_cmd
  description: Run a READ-ONLY command silently in background. Only: cat, ls, grep, pwd, echo, ps, df, free, uname, which, find, head, tail, wc, stat, env, printenv. NO write/execute commands.
  params:
    cmd: string — read-only shell command (required)
- name: check_battery
  description: Get current battery level and charging status.
  params: None
- name: get_active_window
  description: Get title and class of currently focused window.
  params: None
- name: list_open_windows
  description: Get a list of all currently open window titles.
  params: None
- name: read_notifications
  description: Read current desktop notifications.
  params: None
- name: open_visible_terminal
  description: Open a visible terminal for the user. USE ONLY when the user asks to launch a GUI app, open a URL explicitly, or run a dangerous command. Do NOT use this for background web searches or info fetching.
  params:
    cmd: string — command to execute visibly (required)
- name: list_memory_keys
  description: List all keys stored in memory. Call this first when you don't know the exact key name.
  params: None
- name: update_memory
  description: Save a fact or preference to persistent memory.
  params:
    key: string — topic key (required)
    data: any — data to store (required)
- name: fetch_memory
  description: Retrieve facts from memory by keys. Uses fuzzy matching — approximate key names work.
  params:
    keys: list of strings — keys to retrieve (required)
- name: simple_scrape
  description: Fast silent background web search. USE THIS ALWAYS when asked to find latest news, info, or search the web.
  params:
    query: string — what to search for (required)
- name: gui_research
  description: Open browser, physically navigate, read results interactively. Slow but powerful.
  params:
    task: string — what to research (required)
- name: speak
  description: Speak text aloud via Kokoro TTS.
  params:
    text: string (required)
- name: done
  description: Signal end of ReAct loop. Always emit this last with your spoken response.
  params:
    speech: string — what to say to the user (required)

  description: Get interactive UI elements in an app or screen region. IMPORTANT: app= takes the PROCESS name (e.g. 'code' for VS Code, 'firefox' for Firefox), NOT the window title. If unsure of the process name, call list_at_spi_apps first. region={x1,y1,x2,y2} filters by screen area (e.g. top bar: {x1:0,y1:0,x2:1920,y2:50}). Returns elements grouped by category: buttons, menu, tabs, inputs, links, content.
  params:
    app: string (optional) — PROCESS name e.g. 'code', 'firefox', 'gnome-terminal-server'
    region: object (optional) — {x1: int, y1: int, x2: int, y2: int} screen region bounding box
- name: list_at_spi_apps
  description: List all apps on the AT-SPI accessibility bus with their process names. Call this first when you don't know the exact app name for get_ui_elements.
  params: None
- name: read_element_text
  description: Read text from a specific UI element by id.
  params:
    id: string — element id from get_ui_elements (required)
- name: find_element_by_label
  description: Find a UI element by its visible label text.
  params:
    label: string — text to search for (required)
- name: click_at
  description: Move cursor to (x, y) and click. ALWAYS use this instead of separate move+click. Get coords from get_ui_elements first. btn defaults to 'left'.
  params:
    x: int — screen x coordinate (from get_ui_elements) (required)
    y: int — screen y coordinate (from get_ui_elements) (required)
    btn: string (optional, default 'left') — left|right|middle
- name: double_click_at
  description: Move cursor to (x, y) and double-click.
  params:
    x: int (required)
    y: int (required)
- name: type_text
  description: Type text at current focus. Supports Unicode.
  params:
    text: string (required)
- name: key_press
  description: Press a keyboard shortcut. e.g. ctrl+c, ctrl+z, Return, ctrl+alt+t.
  params:
    keys: string — key combo e.g. ctrl+s (required)
- name: scroll
  description: Scroll at current cursor position.
  params:
    direction: string — up|down
    amount: int — scroll steps (default 3)
- name: run_bg_cmd
  description: Run a READ-ONLY command silently in background. Only: cat, ls, grep, pwd, echo, ps, df, free, uname, which, find, head, tail, wc, stat, env, printenv. NO write/execute commands.
  params:
    cmd: string — read-only shell command (required)
- name: check_battery
  description: Get current battery level and charging status.
  params: None
- name: get_active_window
  description: Get title and class of currently focused window.
  params: None
- name: list_open_windows
  description: Get a list of all currently open window titles.
  params: None
- name: read_notifications
  description: Read current desktop notifications.
  params: None
- name: open_visible_terminal
  description: Open a visible terminal for the user. USE ONLY when the user asks to launch a GUI app, open a URL explicitly, or run a dangerous command. Do NOT use this for background web searches or info fetching.
  params:
    cmd: string — command to execute visibly (required)
- name: list_memory_keys
  description: List all keys stored in memory. Call this first when you don't know the exact key name.
  params: None
- name: update_memory
  description: Save a fact or preference to persistent memory.
  params:
    key: string — topic key (required)
    data: any — data to store (required)
- name: fetch_memory
  description: Retrieve facts from memory by keys. Uses fuzzy matching — approximate key names work.
  params:
    keys: list of strings — keys to retrieve (required)
- name: simple_scrape
  description: Fast silent background web search. USE THIS ALWAYS when asked to find latest news, info, or search the web.
  params:
    query: string — what to search for (required)
- name: gui_research
  description: Open browser, physically navigate, read results interactively. Slow but powerful.
  params:
    task: string — what to research (required)
- name: speak
  description: Speak text aloud via Kokoro TTS.
  params:
    text: string (required)
- name: done
  description: Signal end of ReAct loop. Always emit this last with your spoken response.
  params:
    speech: string — what to say to the user (required)

  params:
    app: string (optional) — PROCESS name e.g. 'code', 'firefox', 'gnome-terminal-server'

  description: List all apps on the AT-SPI accessibility bus with their process names. Call this first when you don't know the exact app name for get_ui_elements.
  params: None
- name: read_element_text
  description: Read text from a specific UI element by id.
  params:
    id: string — element id from get_ui_elements (required)
- name: find_element_by_label
  description: Find a UI element by its visible label text.
  params:
    label: string — text to search for (required)

  description: Move cursor to (x, y) and click. ALWAYS use this instead of separate move+click. Get coords from get_ui_elements first. btn defaults to 'left'.
  params:
    x: int — screen x coordinate (from get_ui_elements) (required)
    y: int — screen y coordinate (from get_ui_elements) (required)
    btn: string (optional, default 'left') — left|right|middle

  description: Move cursor to (x, y) and double-click.
  params:
    x: int (required)
    y: int (required)
- name: type_text
  description: Type text at current focus. Supports Unicode.
  params:
    text: string (required)
- name: key_press
  description: Press a keyboard shortcut. e.g. ctrl+c, ctrl+z, Return, ctrl+alt+t.
  params:
    keys: string — key combo e.g. ctrl+s (required)
- name: scroll
  description: Scroll at current cursor position.
  params:
    direction: string — up|down
    amount: int — scroll steps (default 3)

  description: Run a READ-ONLY command silently in background. Only: cat, ls, grep, pwd, echo, ps, df, free, uname, which, find, head, tail, wc, stat, env, printenv. NO write/execute commands.
  params:
    cmd: string — read-only shell command (required)

  description: Get current battery level and charging status.
  params: None

  description: Get title and class of currently focused window.
  params: None
- name: list_open_windows
  description: Get a list of all currently open window titles.
  params: None
- name: read_notifications
  description: Read current desktop notifications.
  params: None

  description: Open a visible terminal for the user. USE ONLY when the user asks to launch a GUI app, open a URL explicitly, or run a dangerous command. Do NOT use this for background web searches or info fetching.

  description: Save a fact or preference to persistent memory.

  description: Get interactive UI elements in an app or screen region. IMPORTANT: app= takes the PROCESS name (e.g. 'code' for VS Code, 'firefox' for Firefox), NOT the window title. If unsure of the process name, call list_at_spi_apps first. region={x1,y1,x2,y2} filters by screen area (e.g. top bar: {x1:0,y1:0,x2:1920,y2:50}). Returns elements grouped by category: buttons, menu, tabs, inputs, links, content.
  params:
    app: string (optional) — PROCESS name e.g. 'code', 'firefox', 'gnome-terminal-server'
    region: object (optional) — {x1: int, y1: int, x2: int, y2: int} screen region bounding box
- name: list_at_spi_apps
  description: List all apps on the AT-SPI accessibility bus with their process names. Call this first when you don't know the exact app name for get_ui_elements.
  params: None
- name: read_element_text
  description: Read text from a specific UI element by id.
  params:
    id: string — element id from get_ui_elements (required)
- name: find_element_by_label
  description: Find a UI element by its visible label text.
  params:
    label: string — text to search for (required)
- name: click_at
  description: Move cursor to (x, y) and click. ALWAYS use this instead of separate move+click. Get coords from get_ui_elements first. btn defaults to 'left'.
  params:
    x: int — screen x coordinate (from get_ui_elements) (required)
    y: int — screen y coordinate (from get_ui_elements) (required)
    btn: string (optional, default 'left') — left|right|middle
- name: double_click_at
  description: Move cursor to (x, y) and double-click.
  params:
    x: int (required)
    y: int (required)
- name: type_text
  description: Type text at current focus. Supports Unicode.
  params:
    text: string (required)
- name: key_press
  description: Press a keyboard shortcut. e.g. ctrl+c, ctrl+z, Return, ctrl+alt+t.
  params:
    keys: string — key combo e.g. ctrl+s (required)
- name: scroll
  description: Scroll at current cursor position.
  params:
    direction: string — up|down
    amount: int — scroll steps (default 3)
- name: run_bg_cmd
  description: Run a READ-ONLY command silently in background. Only: cat, ls, grep, pwd, echo, ps, df, free, uname, which, find, head, tail, wc, stat, env, printenv. NO write/execute commands.
  params:
    cmd: string — read-only shell command (required)
- name: check_battery
  description: Get current battery level and charging status.
  params: None
- name: get_active_window
  description: Get title and class of currently focused window.
  params: None
- name: list_open_windows
  description: Get a list of all currently open window titles.
  params: None
- name: read_notifications
  description: Read current desktop notifications.
  params: None
- name: open_visible_terminal
  description: Open a visible terminal for the user. USE ONLY when the user asks to launch a GUI app, open a URL explicitly, or run a dangerous command. Do NOT use this for background web searches or info fetching.
  params:
    cmd: string — command to execute visibly (required)
- name: list_memory_keys
  description: List all keys stored in memory. Call this first when you don't know the exact key name.
  params: None
- name: update_memory
  description: Save a fact or preference to persistent memory.
  params:
    key: string — topic key (required)
    data: any — data to store (required)
- name: fetch_memory
  description: Retrieve facts from memory by keys. Uses fuzzy matching — approximate key names work.
  params:
    keys: list of strings — keys to retrieve (required)
- name: simple_scrape
  description: Fast silent background web search. USE THIS ALWAYS when asked to find latest news, info, or search the web.
  params:
    query: string — what to search for (required)
- name: gui_research
  description: Open browser, physically navigate, read results interactively. Slow but powerful.
  params:
    task: string — what to research (required)
- name: speak
  description: Speak text aloud via Kokoro TTS.
  params:
    text: string (required)
- name: done
  description: Signal end of ReAct loop. Always emit this last with your spoken response.
  params:
    speech: string — what to say to the user (required)
